contentHtml:
Make your process of residence visa renew in Dubai and stay updated within the advanced and dazzling city of UAE. Renewing your residence visa is your ticket to excitement continued and opportunity in this vibrant city. Whether you’re settling into your routine or planning your next big move, keeping your residency status current.

Breeze through the simplified processing of renewal of visa. Stay focused on enjoying all that Dubai has to offer without the hassle. Let’s dive into the trouble-free way to keep your dreams of living alive!

What is a residence visa in UAE?

It’s an official permit that allows international citizens to live and work in the United Arab Emirates and comes in the form of a Residence visa. It is accessible for an extended period. With this visa, you can legally reside. This enables you to enjoy wide-ranging perks. This may include such as access to local services, healthcare, and education.

It is specially designed for expatriates who wish to establish a long-term presence in the UAE. Be it for employment, family relocation, or other personal reasons, anyone can gain access to living in the UAE.

Validity of UAE Residence Visa

The UAE residence visa generally stays valid from one to three years. However, it changes with the different types of visas and the sponsor. Here’s a closer view of the various durations:

Employment-Based Residence Visa

This one is dependent on the terms of employment and the sponsorship provided by the employer. Generally, it’s applicable for one or two years. It is renewable as long as you continue to meet the employment conditions and the employer renews the sponsorship.

Investor or Business Owner Visa

Often issued for three years. The purpose of business visa services in UAE is designed for individuals who invest in or own a business in the UAE. It is renewable, provided the investment or business remains active.

Family or Dependent Visa

Usually valid for one or two years. The purpose of family visa service in UAE is for family members of UAE residents, including spouses and children. It is tied to the validity of the primary resident’s visa.

See More: Residence Visa For Child in UAE: Application, Fees, & Documents

Retirement Visa

This visa can be issued for up to five years for retirees. It is renewable and requires proof of sufficient financial resources and a certain age requirement.

Importance of renewal residence visa in Dubai

Timely renewal is vital for a smooth and trouble-free living experience in Dubai. Helping you comply with local laws and regulations, comes with a lot of advantages.

  • Legal Status – It ensures you maintain your legal residency status in the UAE. Staying in the country without a valid visa can lead to fines or legal issues.
  • Access to Services – availing of the various services is made easy. These services include such as healthcare, education for dependents, and opening bank accounts.
  • Employment – If you’re working, your employer usually requires a valid visa for payroll and other employment benefits.
  • Travel Flexibility – A current visa facilitates easier travel in and out of the UAE without complications at immigration.
  • Residency Benefits – gaining access to benefits tied to residency. It is feasible to renew with the visa. The perks may range from such as property ownership or long-term lease agreements.
  • Avoiding Fines – preventing penalties associated with overstaying your visa by renewing on time.

Step-by-step process for how to Renew Residence Visa In Dubai

Start with the Essentials

Begin by filling out the Emirates ID application form. It is a significant step for renewing your residence visa. Complete this process online through the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship website or at an authentic typing center.

Prepare Required Documents

Gather necessary documents such as your current residence visa, passport copies, and any other required identification. All information must be accurately filled to avoid delays.

Submit Your Application

Handover your completed application along with the required documents to the relevant authorities. This step sets the stage for receiving your renewed Emirates ID.

Proceed with the Medical Fitness Inspection

Schedule an Appointment

Book an appointment for a medical fitness test at an approved health center. This inspection is significant to make sure that you align with the UAE’s health requirements.

Undergo the Examination

Attend the medical fitness test, which typically includes a general health check and a blood test. Results are usually available within a few days.

Receive Your Fitness Certificate

You will receive a fitness certificate if you have passed the medical exam, you will receive a fitness certificate, which is essential for the visa renewal process.

Renew the Right of Residence

Visit the GDRFA: Submit your renewal application to the GDRFA, either online or in person. Include all required documents, such as the medical fitness certificate and a copy of your current residence visa.

Pay the Renewal Fee: Ensure you pay the applicable renewal fees. Payment can be made online or at authorized payment centers.

Await Approval: After submitting your application and payment, wait for approval. The GDRFA will process your request and issue a renewed residence visa once all requirements are met.

Obtain an Updated Emirates ID and a Copy of Your Passport:

Receive Your Emirates ID

Once your residence visa is renewed, you will receive an updated Emirates ID.  This displays your new visa status. Collect it from the Emirates ID Authority or have it delivered to your registered address.

Update Passport Copy

Ensure that you update your passport copy with the new visa information. This step is crucial for maintaining accurate records and for future reference.

Keep Documents Safe

Store your renewed residence visa, updated Emirates ID, and passport copy securely. These documents are essential for various administrative and legal processes in Dubai.

By following these steps, you’ll efficiently renew your residence visa in Dubai and ensure that all your documentation is current and in order.

Document Requirements to renew a residence visa in Dubai

Ensure all documents are up-to-date and accurate to facilitate a smooth renewal process

  • Original and a copy of your existing residence visa.
  • A valid passport with at least six months remaining validity, plus a copy.
  • Your current Emirates ID and a copy.
  • Proof of passing the medical fitness test, obtained from an approved health center.
  • Recent passport-sized photographs (usually in color, meeting UAE specifications).
  • Employment contract or a letter from your sponsor, depending on your visa type.
  • Receipt of payment for the visa renewal fee.

What are the UAE residence visa renewal fees in 2024?

The fees for renewing a UAE residence visa change with the factors. It depends on the visa duration and type. Following is the summarized view:

  • 1-Year Visa Renewal: Approximately AED 1,000 to AED 2,000 (depending on the emirate and visa category).
  • 2-Year Visa Renewal: Approximately AED 2,000 to AED 4,000.
  • 3-Year Visa Renewal: Approximately AED 3,000 to AED 6,000.

Medical Fitness Test: Required for all visa renewals.

Emirates ID Renewal: Fees for updating your Emirates ID in line with the renewed visa.

Administrative Fees: Potential extra costs for processing and administrative services.

For precise and latest information, it’s best to consult with the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs or relevant authorities.
